about_the_game:
In Lost Episodes Alone you play as Michael. A 10 year old boy living in a quiet, isolated town where something sinister lurks in the shadows. When your friend Roger vanishes, you uncover a dark presence Valak has taken him. She haunts Michael and his friends Roger, Joel, Dave and Hannah in their nightmares. Once the nightmare is over another intruder breaks in while Michael is home alone. Call for help or find a way to survive the intruder. 

-Run from Valak and survive her pursuit during nightmares.

-Collect keys to unlock symbol doors similar to Resident Evil.

-Collect memories similar to pages in Slenderman.

-Read notes to find clues and solve puzzles.

-Find a way to survive the intruder at night.

Playtime: 30-60 Minutes.

Disclaimer: Loud noises and jump scares. Best played with headset in a dark setting.

Each episodes in the series follows Michael and his friends as they grow older and experience new horrors. 

This game is developed and produced by one person.

short_description: Lost Episodes Alone is an indie survival horror game. Play as Michael a 10 year old boy. Save your friends from an evil nun named Valak and intruders. Find clues and solve puzzles to escape the nightmare. Inspired by games like Resident evil, Slenderman and other horror titles!
